title: Juicy Crumbly Middle Eastern Beetroot Maqluba
description: A fatty and crumbly Middle Eastern dish featuring cooked beetroot, perfect for a romantic dinner, this flexitarian-friendly maqluba is made in a kadhai vessel and incorporates fermented elements for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Heat the lamb fat in the kadhai over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the diced beetroot and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is tender and lightly browned.
Stir in the fermented yogurt, sumac, salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the crushed pita bread to the kadhai and stir to combine with the beetroot mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the maqluba hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
